chart_title.description: Reserved for the chart pipeline; validated but not yet used. Must not contain em-dashes or en-dashes. Max 120 characters. Optional.

closing_costs.description: Explicit closing costs in dollars, excluding points; total upfront cost is closing_costs plus the points cost. Decimal from 0 to 1,000,000,000. Optional; omitting it uses the cited default of 0.67% of the loan (LodeStar 2026). An IMMEDIATE break-even requires total upfront cost to be zero (or non-positive) AND monthly_savings to be non-negative, i.e. closing_costs AND points both 0, not closing_costs alone; a zero-total-cost refi into a worse deal (negative monthly_savings) reports NEAR_ZERO_OR_NEGATIVE_SAVINGS instead.

compute_economic_break_even.description: Whether to compute the economic (net-worth crossover) break-even. When false, only the cash-flow break-even and interest delta are returned, and economic_break_even reports NOT_REQUESTED. Optional; defaults to true when omitted.

current_annual_rate_pct.description: Current loan's annual rate as a percentage, e.g. 6.5 not 0.065. Decimal from 0 to 20. REQUIRED, no default.

current_balance.description: Outstanding principal you would refinance. Decimal, greater than 0 and at most 1,000,000,000. REQUIRED, no default.

current_monthly_payment.description: Your actual statement P&I payment. Decimal, greater than 0 and at most 1,000,000,000. Optional; when supplied it overrides the formula-derived payment, so match your statement.

investment_return_pct.description: Annual return used for the economic (invest-the-savings) break-even, an EFFECTIVE ANNUAL rate; the monthly compounding step is (1+pct/100)^(1/12)-1. Decimal from 0 to 30. Optional; omitting it uses the cited long-run S&P 500 nominal total-return default, about 10%; call list_defaults for the exact current value.

new_annual_rate_pct.description: The offered refinance rate as a percentage. Decimal from 0 to 20. REQUIRED, no default.

new_term_months.description: The new loan term in months. Integer from 1 to 480. REQUIRED, no default.

points.description: Discount points paid at closing, where 1.0 means 1% of the loan. Decimal from 0 to 4. Optional; defaults to 0 when omitted.

remaining_term_months.description: Months left on the current loan. Integer from 1 to 480. REQUIRED, no default.

roll_costs_into_loan.description: Whether closing costs and points are added to the new principal instead of paid upfront; cash-flow break-even then reports COSTS_ROLLED_INTO_LOAN. Optional; defaults to false when omitted.
